consultations.diagnosis: Essential Stage 1 Hypertension with Sinus Tachycardia
consultations.observations: BP: 142/90 mmHg. Heart Rate: 84 bpm regular. S1/S2 heard, no murmurs. Chest clear to auscultation. Minimal bilateral pitting ankle edema.
consultations.treatmentPlan:
1. Lifestyle modification: DASH diet, sodium restriction (<2g/day), 30 minutes brisk walking daily.
2. Pharmacotherapy: Start Tab Amlodipine 5mg OD morning.
3. Baseline laboratory investigations: Serum electrolytes, Creatinine, Lipid profile, Urine microalbumin.
4. Repeat BP charting for 7 days.
consultations.doctorNotes: Patient motivated to adopt lifestyle interventions. Discussed warning signs of hypertensive urgency. Follow-up after 10 days.
